name: A. Bond recipe engine (core + parsers + validation receipt)
goal: Ship perceiveBonds() (lupi-bonds.molecular.v1 and lupi-bonds.distance.v1), filterPerceivedBonds() and bondMethodParagraph()/bondMethodSentence() in @atlas/core/bonds; add the optional bondPairs input to computeObjectFacts; parse Frame.chemistry, Frame.sourceRecord and Frame.periodic from XYZ and carry them across the parse worker; run the local harness and commit validation-v1.json as the release prerequisite.
steps: Commit this strategy doc as docs/omol25-bonds-and-discovery.md.

Add the exports "./bonds": "./src/bonds/index.ts" and "./omol25": "./src/omol25/index.ts" to packages/core/package.json. Track C creates the omol25 folder; until it merges, add a placeholder index.ts that exports nothing, and Track C replaces it.

classes.ts: element class Z sets; Shannon cation radii; donor contact radii with source comments (O, F, Cl, Br, I, S: Shannon CN6; N: Shannon CN4; P: Pauling); high-spin radii Mn 1.61, Fe 1.52, Co 1.50; valence caps; ion CN caps; REMOVAL_REASON. Compute MAX_ION_CONTACT_A = max r_ion + max r_donor + ION_CONTACT_MARGIN_A (4.35) from the tables; do not type it as a literal. Mark every Lupi choice with a `// Lupi choice: harness sensitivity` comment.
grid.ts: a uniform grid whose cell is the largest cutoff present (≤ 6 Å). Fixed cell iteration order; canonical i<j; de-duplicated.

perceive.ts, steps 1–9 exactly as in strategy 2.3: candidates; H–H, ignoring metal–H candidates; one partner per H, with B–H–B bridging, the η²-H₂ exception and hydrides (at most 2); the bridged-pair rule (drop B–B or M–M when both atoms keep a bond to the same bridging H); the acute angle (covalent centres only; bridging B–H exempt); valence caps in descending stretch (bridging B–H never dropped, each counts 1 toward B); haptic trim at 1.15 and metal cap 12; ion donor precedence 0.15 Å and CN caps; then recompute every count, including bridgingH and ionCarbonClose, from the final graph. Output sorted by (i,j).
Determinism: d² in float64; squared comparisons; one sqrt per stretch; no hypot or trig; explicit (i,j) tie-breaks.
Distance recipe: every pair with 0 < d ≤ r_i+r_j+τ, kind covalent (today's rule A).
filter.ts: filterPerceivedBonds(p, {types, hiddenTypes, showContacts}) returns DrawnBonds, with sourceIndex back into p.

select.ts: selectBondRecipe() per the contract (Frame.periodic must be === false; auto molecular needs chemistry and frameCount===1 or an OMol25 record; forced molecular needs periodic===false and ≤ 2000 atoms).
method.ts: bondMethodParagraph(params) and bondMethodSentence(opts), generated from the constants (strategy 2.11 wording: 'least-stretched partner', 'most stretched bonds', the 45° clause).
objectFacts/index.ts: ObjectFactsOptions gains bondPairs?: ArrayLike<number>. When present, build the BondGraph (pairs plus adjacency) from it instead of computeBonds. Default behaviour unchanged.
core types.ts: FrameChemistry, FrameSourceRecord, and optional Frame.chemistry / Frame.sourceRecord / Frame.periodic. Do not touch Frame.bonds or the digest code.

xyzParser.parseComment: read charge=, multiplicity= / spin_multiplicity=, charge_source=, data_id=, collection=, row=, method=, energy_eV=, max_force_eV_per_A=, homo_lumo_gap_eV=, license=, source=. Never read a bare spin=. Set periodic = Lattice= present. Attach chemistry only when charge=, multiplicity= or charge_source= is present ('file-declared' when there is no charge_source). Attach sourceRecord when the comment starts with 'OMol25 '. frame.properties gains no entries.
Carry chemistry, sourceRecord and periodic through frameTransfer.ts, parse.worker.ts and hydrateWorkerFrame.

tools/omol25-bonds (local Node, not CI). fetch-rows.mts pages neutral-validation through the HF rows API with a cache. run.mts runs both recipes and writes validation-v1.json: hard targets, reported distributions, the sensitivity table, the share of rows changed, and p50/p95/p99. gallery-diff.mts runs over the gallery XYZ files of ≤ 2,000 atoms. RUN IT ONCE and commit validation-v1.json in this track; the release that deploys v1 requires it. If a hard target misses, fix the rule and re-run.
unitTests: water/methane/caffeine expected covalent counts; the distance recipe on caffeine equals today's r+r+0.45 pairs
H2 kept; η²-H2 on a metal keeps the H–H plus 2 coordination; crowded H–H dropped (hydrogen-pair); a stretched second C–H dropped (hydrogen-single-partner)
diborane: the B–B is removed with reason bridged-pair, both bridging H keep 2 B partners, each B has exactly 4 covalent bonds, counts.bridgingH = 2
a 0.35 Å pair is not bonded and is counted in clashes
ClO4- gives 4 Cl–O, PF6- gives 6, IF7 gives 7; Cl with two C partners keeps 1

[Na(H2O)6]+ gives 6 ionicContact and 0 covalent pairs touching Na; K+ by sulfonate keeps K···O and drops K···S; K+ in 12 waters is capped at 10; an Fr–I pair at 4.30 Å is contacted (MAX_ION_CONTACT_A = 4.35)
a Li near a carbon at 2.1 Å gives no pair and ionCarbonClose = 1
ferrocene gives 10 coordination bonds and no acute-angle removal at Fe; cisplatin gives 4 coordination
determinism: the same input twice and a shuffled grid insertion order give byte-equal output
fuzz: covalent d ≤ r_i+r_j+τ; coordination within its own rule; contacts ≤ MAX_ION_CONTACT_A
filterPerceivedBonds: hiding a type and turning contacts off keeps kinds/distances/sourceIndex aligned

selectBondRecipe truth table: source bonds; inference not allowed; periodic undefined/true; > 2000 atoms; multi-frame auto → distance; multi-frame OMol25 record → molecular; forced molecular on periodic undefined → distance
bondMethodParagraph contains 'least-stretched' and '45°' and the 0.45 value taken from the constant
computeObjectFacts with bondPairs uses them (ring found only when the pairs close it); without bondPairs the output is unchanged

xyzParser: an OMol25 comment populates chemistry/sourceRecord/periodic=false; a bare spin= is ignored; Lattice= gives periodic=true; positions/types/properties are identical with and without the new keys
frameTransfer round-trips chemistry, sourceRecord and periodic

name: C. Edge OMol25 data, shared omol25 core module and featured picks
goal: The edge passes through charge, spin, domain, gap and force with correct provenance, gets timeouts, a guarded Cache API and exposed headers; the five duplicated collection lists move into @atlas/core/omol25 (collections, urls, truth strings, featured types); and the committed 24-pick featured data is produced.
steps: collections.ts / urls.ts / truth.ts / featured.ts exactly per the shared contracts (sourceRows, the citation, the exact truth strings, OmolFeaturedFileV1 plus a shape validator).

scienceData.ts: import the collections from core. compactOmolRow parses property_metadata defensively (integer charge |q| ≤ 10, spin 1–11; truncated or unparsable → 'unavailable'; neutral-train → 0/1 'split-definition'). Add charge, spinMultiplicity, chargeSource, domain, homoLumoGapEv (the first list entry) and metaTruncated. Keep multiplicity, documented as not spin.
XYZ comment: the keys and their order exactly per the contract; no Properties=. Keep bonds=not-provided and x-lupi-bond-topology; add x-lupi-charge-provenance and x-lupi-bond-inference.
index.ts: append x-lupi-charge-provenance and x-lupi-bond-inference to the access-control-expose-headers string at lines 2305-2309. Nothing else in index.ts.
Timeouts: AbortSignal.timeout 9 s (rows/filter/search) and 12 s (structure) → 504 {status:'slow'}. A truncated positions cell gives an explicit 502 message.

Structure cache: add an injectable options.cache using the existing guarded pattern `options.cache === undefined ? (globalThis as { caches?: { default?: Cache } }).caches?.default ?? null : options.cache` (as in gist.ts:262). Skip caching when it is null. Key it with a URL that includes 'omol25-xyz-v2'. Do not reference a bare `caches.default` (tsc with types: [] has no .default, and Node vitest has no caches).
Manifest reports sourceRows.

remoteOmol.ts: the row type gains the new fields; the subtitle per the contract; drop the multiplicity subtitle; fill provenance/notice from truth.ts; map 504 'slow' to a typed OmolSlowError (D renders it), keeping the existing warming error unchanged.
remoteMoleculeUrlPolicy.ts: OMOL25_COLLECTION_IDS from core; isTrustedScienceDataUrl also accepts ^/datasets/omol25/featured/omol25_nv_\d+\.xyz$.
mcp/tools.ts browse_collection: the new row fields; sourceTruth.viewerBonds. No input schema change.

tools/build-omol25-featured.mjs (network, run once, output committed): fetch the rows, write the XYZ in the edge comment format, sha256, the gates (12–120 atoms, min distance ≥ 0.7 Å, and via perceiveBonds: one partner per H, no over-valent atom, 0 covalent s-block sticks), featured.v1.json, generate omolShelf.data.ts, write a contact sheet to scratch. Hand-pick 24 rows across the six shelves, covering all 17 elements, with ≥ 12 home picks; titles are Hill formulas.
docs/external-science-data.md: the row fields, comment keys, headers, timeouts, cache and featured files.
dependsOn: A. Bond recipe engine (core + parsers + validation receipt) (only for the picks drawability gate; the edge and core module work is independent)
unitTests: compactOmolRow: a validation row with property_metadata {charge:1, spin:3} gives charge 1, spinMultiplicity 3, 'record' while the multiplicity column says 1
compactOmolRow: neutral-train gives 0/1 'split-definition'; truncated metadata gives 'unavailable' without failing the page
the structure XYZ comment contains charge=, multiplicity=, charge_source=, bonds=not-provided and no Properties=
an upstream timeout returns 504 {status:'slow'} (fake fetch)
structure route with no cache (undefined global caches) still responds; with an injected fake cache the second call is a hit and the key contains 'omol25-xyz-v2'
the CORS expose-headers string contains x-lupi-charge-provenance and x-lupi-bond-inference
the truth.ts strings match the contract exactly, including 'OMol25 supplies no bond topology' / 'OMol25 supplies no bonds'
isOmol25Url/parseOmolStructurePath for the edge and featured paths; the URL policy accepts picks and rejects other /datasets paths
remoteOmolHit subtitle '· charge +1 · doublet' only when non-default; never 'multiplicity'
featured.v1.json and omolShelf.data.ts pass the shape validator

name: B. Bond rendering, provenance UI, Object Facts, exports and MCP (scene + viewer)
goal: Use getPerceivedBonds for molecular frames everywhere in the viewer: dashed/dotted kinds through the colour alpha byte, the legend, the Learn section, the atom card, Structure guides (brp/bco), Object Facts on the same graph, the OMol25 source card, model exports with three named meshes, the validator fix, and the MCP status/viewer_state/set_viewer fields.
steps: perceivedBonds.ts: getPerceivedBonds(frame, {recipe, tolerance}) memoised in a WeakMap on frame.positions (inner Map keyed `${recipe}|${tolerance}`), plus resolveFrameRecipe(frame, {profile, frameCount}) wrapping selectBondRecipe with sourceBondCount, inferenceAllowed (canInferCovalentBonds), Frame.periodic, chemistry and sourceRecord. Atomic numbers come from resolveAtomicNumber (as in objectFactsForFile).
bondTopology.ts: shouldUseGpuBondInference gains an optional recipe argument and returns false for the molecular recipe; the existing signature and tests are unchanged.

Bonds.tsx: new props recipe/frameCount/showBondContacts. For molecular, call getPerceivedBonds synchronously on the main thread (no worker post, no GPU), then filterPerceivedBonds with hidden types and contacts, then write instances: radius × BOND_KIND_RADIUS_SCALE[kind], colour alpha = BOND_KIND_STYLE_ALPHA[kind]. The stale-bond collapse runs on kind 0 only. onBondsUpdate passes a BondsUpdateDetail (counts). The distance path is unchanged.

bondImpostorMaterial.ts: decode the alpha byte as a style code (k = round(a·3); 3 solid, 2 dashed 0.30 Å/0.60, 1 dotted 0.16 Å/0.45) and discard on fract(axialÅ/period) > duty, phase-centred. writeBondColor's default stays 255. The ink branch inherits the discard.

ViewerScene.tsx: compute recipe via resolveFrameRecipe (profile from the store; frameCount from the loaded trajectory's frame count); pass it into Bonds. For molecular frames, bondStubReach = 2·max r_cov over the non-ion, non-inert elements present + τ.

store.ts: bondProfile ('auto'|'distance'|'molecular'; URL delta key `brp` = 'd'|'m', omitted for auto), showBondContacts (default true; URL delta key `bco` = 0 when false), lastBondDetail. Do NOT use `bp` (backgroundPitchDegrees, store.ts:1159) or `bc` (bondCutoff, store.ts:1176); grep every delta.* key before adding. reportBondsUpdate takes an optional detail. Auto showCell stays false for frames with chemistry and periodic === false. savedViews.ts persists brp/bco, and frameToXyz writes charge=/multiplicity=/charge_source=/data_id= back.

SceneModControls/MoleculeControls: keep the 'Bond guides' label; add Bond rule (Molecular v1 / Distance only) and the Contacts toggle, with the hint per 2.11; the GPU toggle copy reads 'for structures without declared chemistry'.
studyFacts.ts: a 'molecular' summary 'Inferred bonds' with counts; distance keeps 'Visual guide only'; inferSourceLabel names the OMol25 collection and row.

BondMethodSection: the paragraph from bondMethodParagraph(); the counts, inputs, not-claimed (with the s-block–carbon clause when ionCarbonClose > 0), long-bond, domain-caveat and clash lines; 'How sure' from validation-v1.json (static import; stub JSON until A merges); Copy method via bondMethodSentence. Omol25SourceCard reads Frame.sourceRecord/chemistry and the truth.ts helpers. Mount both in StudyLensPanel.

BondLegendHUD: DOM only, stacked above PropertyLegendHUD, a viewInset occluder, collapse behaviour per motion comfort, SVG swatches with text labels. Mount it in ViewerApp next to <PropertyLegendHUD>.
AtomInfoHUD: 'Bonded to … (inferred)' and 'Ionic contacts: …' from getPerceivedBonds + filterPerceivedBonds for the selected atom, only when the recipe is molecular.

objectFactsForFile(frame, opts?): opts.bondPairs is passed to computeObjectFacts. CameraToys resolves the recipe with resolveFrameRecipe; when it is molecular, it passes the covalent+coordination pairs from getPerceivedBonds (unfiltered by contacts, which are excluded anyway). The distance recipe is unchanged.

exportSceneBuilder.detectExportBonds: for molecular, use getPerceivedBonds + filterPerceivedBonds (the same filter as the view); build the meshes lupi-bonds-covalent, lupi-bonds-coordination and lupi-contacts-ionic (dash/dot segments with the same period and duty; the budget counts segments) with userData {lupiBondRecipe, lupiBondKind, lupiProvenance:'inferred'}. ExportManager passes the recipe and frameCount.

renderArtifact.ts bonds layer: requireExactKeys(value, [...allowed, 'topology','recipe','contacts'], [...required unchanged]) plus enum checks. The adapter writes topology/recipe/contacts from resolveFrameRecipe and drops sourceBondCount. Raster-with-bonds still throws.

mcpViewerBridge/driver/schemas: status and viewer_state add bondRecipe, bondToleranceAdjusted, bondKinds, bondEvidence and chemistry; viewer_state includeBonds returns the filtered view from getPerceivedBonds (cap 5,000, bondsTruncated, bondsFilter); set_viewer accepts bondProfile and showBondContacts; replace the hard-coded OMol25 collection enum with OMOL25_COLLECTION_IDS. Run pnpm run generate:mcp-manifest.
AGENTS.md: the status example plus bond notes, the /v1/datasets/omol25* endpoints and /datasets/omol25/featured.v1.json, and the browse_collection row fields.
dependsOn: A. Bond recipe engine (core + parsers + validation receipt)
C. Edge OMol25 data, shared omol25 core module and featured picks (truth.ts and OMOL25_COLLECTION_IDS only)
unitTests: renderArtifact validator: bonds with topology/recipe/contacts accepted; sourceBondCount rejected; omitting the optional keys is still valid
renderArtifactAdapter: a GLB with showBonds:true validates and records the recipe; raster with showBonds still throws
getPerceivedBonds returns the same object for the same frame/recipe/τ and a new one when τ changes

store URL round-trip: bondProfile writes brp, showBondContacts writes bco=0; an existing link with bp=12 still restores backgroundPitchDegrees 12 and bc=3.5 still restores bondCutoff; defaults omitted
shouldUseGpuBondInference returns false for molecular and is unchanged otherwise
studyFacts: the molecular summary 'Inferred bonds' with counts; distance is still 'Visual guide only'
bondStubReach excludes s-block ions
objectFactsForFile with bondPairs from a K+ salt frame finds no ring through K
exportSceneBuilder: a Na(H2O)6+ frame yields the three named meshes with deterministic segment counts and the userData provenance

name: D. OMol25 surfaces (home, nav, finder, Library, palette, switcher, ink, SEO, analytics, contract)
goal: Make OMol25 prominent: nav item, home shelf after the hero, finder handoffs, a Library that leads with OMol25, random over 34.3M rows, palette and switcher entries, pick ink drawn with perceiveBonds, SEO copy, entry tagging and the recorded contract amendment.
steps: Record the 2026-10-03 contract amendment (strategy 4.1) in both docs.

SiteHeader: Molecules · OMol25 · Daily · Library · Scan · How to use · Open a file; SiteSection 'omol25'; LibraryShell passes it at /library/omol25; the static /m and /daily top bars get the same link; viewerRoutes maps /omol25 → /library/omol25.

OmolShelf.tsx + omol-shelf.css + omolShelf.ts: render synchronously from OMOL_PICKS directly after the hero, before DailyCard; six tiles via omolShelfForDay(); copy, actions, Save-Data, sizes and budgets per strategy 4.3; no .student-card, canvas or analytics import; the open helper calls prefetchViewer, markOpenEntry and dynamically imports openMolecule; if an ink img fails to load, show a text mark.

MoleculeFinder: the '· 34.3M in OMol25' scope link, up to 3 pick matches (kind 'omol') after gallery and before PubChem, and the formula-shaped handoff using isFormulaShapedForOmol → /library/omol25?view=facets&q=. Update MoleculeFinder.test.tsx for the new 'omol' kind.
LandingFooter links; fix the stale copy at main.tsx:239-240 and SeoEducationPage.tsx:43; seo-routes.json (home description, libraryOmol25); llms.txt OMol25 section.
LibraryPage nav order per 4.3; an 'OMol25 picks' row of 6 on /library.

Omol25Collection: shelves from featured.v1.json; masthead copy (keep the asserted phrase and the .library-coverage line; use sourceRows; change the 'copies no rows' sentence); groups= in the URL via useLibraryQuery; Prev/Next '1–36 of N'; Random in this filter; render OmolSlowError as 'OMol25's host is slow to answer. Try again in a moment.'; keep the existing warming sentence unchanged so Omol25Collection.test.tsx:75 (/warming.*15 seconds/) stays green; never show raw abort text; remote Random row picks one row. Update Omol25Collection.test.tsx only for the masthead sentence change.
providers/omol.ts: rank exact formula matches before slicing. search.ts: each provider races a 6,000 ms timeout; omol tie-break 6 → 2.
LibraryCard: the truth line from omolCardTruth().
randomOmol.ts/RandomStructure: a uniform crypto integer over neutral-train sourceRows, no index download, failure copy, lede.
ViewerApp palette Discover entries; switcher idle 'From OMol25' group (4 picks with ink tiles, separate from LOCAL_MOLECULES); omolTitle() everywhere.
openEntry.ts (sessionStorage 'lupi.openEntry', 30 s expiry, try/catch); sourceKind 'omol25' via isOmol25Url; molecule_loaded gains entry.
